svg.title: The same four bases counted two ways: chr1:3-6 in in-base coordinates, numbering the bases, and chr1 2 6 in BED's interbase coordinates, numbering the gaps between bases
svg.text: Two ways to count the same bases
Both name the four highlighted bases on chr1
In-base: SAM, VCF and samtools number the bases
Interbase: BED numbers the gaps between bases
from base 3 to base 6, both included
from gap 2 to gap 6, so 6 − 2 = 4 bases
